title: Staff can sign in and reach the backoffice
description: This verifies that a valid staff login succeeds and the user lands in the protected backoffice area.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the sign-in form
Verify the user lands in the backoffice area
Verify authorized backoffice content is displayed

title: Unauthenticated user is redirected away from cashier screen
description: This verifies that accessing the cashier screen without signing in does not expose protected content and sends the user to the login page.

steps.description: Navigate to /pos
Verify the user is sent to the login page
Verify the cashier screen is not displayed

title: Unauthenticated user is redirected away from protected product catalog
description: This verifies that accessing the product catalog without signing in does not expose protected content and sends the user to the login page.

steps.description: Navigate to /backoffice/products
Verify the user is sent to the login page
Verify protected product catalog content is not displayed

title: Authenticated staff can open the cashier screen
description: This verifies that a signed-in staff member can reach the cashier screen for in-store sales.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the sign-in form
Click the link to open the cashier screen
Verify the cashier screen is displayed
Verify cashier controls are available

title: Branch staff can browse their product catalog

steps.description: Navigate to /login

Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the sign-in form
Click the link to open the product catalog
Verify the product table is displayed
Verify branch-scoped products are displayed

title: Branch staff can open the new product form

Verify company branches are displayed

title: View the full branch list
description: A master or authorized staff member can open the branch management page and see the company branch list.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form

title: Staff sees validation for incorrect login credentials
description: This verifies that invalid login credentials are rejected and the login page shows validation feedback instead of granting access.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with invalid@example.com
Fill in the password field with invalid-password
Submit the sign-in form
Verify login validation feedback is visible
Verify protected backoffice content is not displayed

title: Staff sees validation for missing login details
description: This verifies that submitting the sign-in form with missing required values keeps the user on the login page and shows validation feedback.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Submit the sign-in form without entering credentials
Verify login validation feedback is visible
Verify the user remains on the login page

Submit the sign-in form

Verify an empty state message is visible
Verify the product catalog page still loads successfully
